modelingNotes: Bank of America Tower (Legacy Union, 620 S Tryon St, 2019, Goldman Sachs / Lincoln Harris; Gensler with LS3P), Charlotte — original procedural geometry, CC0-1.0. bun generators/clt-bank-of-america-tower.ts
Not the 1992 Bank of America Corporate Center (bank-of-america-corporate- center.ts); this is the 33-storey tower of 2019 at the head of Legacy Union.

Map frame: x east, y north, z up, metres; origin at the anchor (the centroid of the OSM outline way/715062087) on the lowest ground. Placed at bearing 49.7, so the tower's faces, square to Uptown's grid, are square to this frame: +x faces South Tryon Street (south-east), +y faces north-east.

Identity, in order: - the glass pyramid on top, pale and lit, on a stepped cream parapet; - the tiered cream tower: a punched-window base with a heavy cornice, a tall shaft of cream piers and blue glass strips, a big cornice and setback about two thirds up, a band of square windows, then a narrower top tier under the crown; - the deep blue glass notches at every corner, stepping in twice, running from the base to the parapet; - the warm cream precast and saturated blue glass, against the plain glass towers around it.

Evidence: - OSM: outline way/715062087 (height 193, 33 levels), parts way/1351689077 (the shaft, 160 m: its plan gives the stepped corners), way/1351689080 (the pyramid on a 34 m square, tagged 160-190 m), way/1409111132 (the Tryon side's wider lower shaft, 124 m), way/1409111131, 1413181399, 1413181400 (the 20 m podium round the foot). Plan dimensions are measured from these, symmetrised where the OSM corners differ by under a metre. - Published: 632 ft / 192.6 m, 33 floors, completed 2019 (CTBUH, via Wikipedia "List of tallest buildings in Charlotte"; Wikipedia "Legacy Union" for the dates). - Lidar: USGS_LPC_NC_Phase4_Mecklenburg_2016 (flown 2016-17) shows the demolished Charlotte Observer building on the site, so it gives no tower heights; it shows the ground falling ~3-4 m to the west. - Heights scaled from Bruce Emmerling's distant, near-orthographic morning skyline photo (below), set to the published 192.6 m tip: base cornice ~48 m, the main setback cornice ~132 m, the square-window band's cornice ~140 m (one row of square windows over the setback), the parapet ~180 m and so a low pyramid of ~12.6 m. OSM's 160 m shaft and 30 m pyramid disagree with every photo (the pyramid is plainly about a third of that) and are not used. - Photos (Wikimedia Commons, all daylight unless noted): "Bank of America Tower December 2023.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bank_of_America_Tower_December_2023.jpg); "Legacy Union September 2023.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Legacy_Union_September_2023.jpg); "Legacy Union April 2023.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Legacy_Union_April_2023.jpg); "Legacy Union November 2022.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, night, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Legacy_Union_November_2022.jpg); "Bank of America Tower South Tryon plaza December 2023.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, the Tryon entrance face, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bank_of_America_Tower_South_Tryon_plaza_December_2023.jpg); "Bank of America Tower Charlotte.jpg" (Jt12081988, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bank_of_America_Tower_Charlotte.jpg); "Bank of America Tower May 2021.jpg" (City Dweller 2, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bank_of_America_Tower_May_2021.jpg); "Legacy Union.jpg" (Cmett003, CC BY-SA 4.0, under construction, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Legacy_Union.jpg); "Charlotte Skyline during the morning.jpg" (Bruce Emmerling, CC BY-SA 4.0, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Charlotte_Skyline_during_the_morning.jpg). No commercial imagery. No look-only sources were used.

Estimated: every tier height above (photo-scaled, ±4 m); the upper tier's inset (1.5-2 m a side, from the cornice's projection in the photos); the bay counts (five strips on the long faces, three on the short, counted on the photos and spaced evenly); the three-storey window groups (an abstraction of the real continuous strips); the podium's height (OSM's 20 m); the pyramid's 28 m base (OSM's 34 m square less the parapet). Invented: nothing beyond the abstraction.

Doubts: the north-west (back) face is only seen obliquely; OSM gives the Tryon side a wider lower shaft (to 124 m) and that is kept, though no photo shows that face square on. Left out: the "BANK OF AMERICA" signs, mullions, the glazed pyramid's lattice, the skybridge to the garage.

Original procedural model from https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks (catalog id "clt-bank-of-america-tower", model "clt-bank-of-america-tower"), generated by https://github.com/alexwohlbruck/landmarks/blob/a1974bbf738c6994edbe99a7a61818b9d69da9e0/generators/clt-bank-of-america-tower.ts. That repository is the editable source; source.blend.gz is the exported mesh imported into Blender for convenience.

Exported for Open Landmarks v1: placement bearing and scale baked in; moving parts frozen in their rest pose; footings and basements below the lowest ground (y = 0) cut away; material colours carried over exactly, as library finishes where they are not standard swatches.
